sql.join: SELECT a.name FROM assets a JOIN country_year_series c ON a.country_iso3 = c.iso3
sql.cte: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM trade_flow) SELECT * FROM t
sql.cte_shadowing_a_table: WITH trade_flow AS (SELECT 1 AS x) SELECT * FROM trade_flow
sql.subquery: SELECT * FROM (SELECT importer_iso3 FROM trade_flow) x WHERE x.importer_iso3 IN (SELECT iso3 FROM country_year_series)
sql.set_operation: SELECT iso3 FROM country_year_series UNION ALL SELECT importer_iso3 FROM trade_flow
sql.scalar_subquery_over_file: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/gie_daily.parquet')) AS n
sql.recursive_cte: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 3) SELECT * FROM r
sql.multi_statement_select_then_ddl: SELECT 1; CREATE TABLE x AS SELECT 1
sql.pivot_top_level_statement: PIVOT (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('a', 1), ('b', 2)) t(k, v)) ON k USING sum(v)
sql.pivot_clause: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('a', 1), ('b', 2)) t(k, v) PIVOT (sum(v) FOR k IN ('a', 'b'))
